customManagers.description: Chart versions pinned per environment in overlay kustomize patches. The flux manager only sees spec.chart.spec.version in the base HelmRelease, and these patches override it — so without this, Renovate raises PRs against a value neither cluster actually renders.

packageRules.description: Keep staging and production bumps in separate PRs so an upgrade can soak on staging before it is promoted.
Promoting to production is a deliberate step, so these wait for approval on the dependency dashboard rather than opening a PR on their own.
